verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs name an official SDK for Singer Connectors and an EDK for Meltano Components, and say users can build their own connectors. A community user independently reports that building a custom tap with the SDK went very well. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation (APIs, supported languages, versioning), and evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented SDK usage beyond connector authoring.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The SDK for Singer Connectors & EDK for Meltano Components are easy to use.
Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination.
When I had to develop a custom tap for a client, the support I received from the team, the SDK and the general experience was absolutely top class.
